summary: Extends the File Transfer Protocol so it works over both IPv4 and IPv6 and across network address translators. It adds new commands for specifying data connection addresses and ports. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: The old FTP told the server its address in a form that only worked with the old internet addresses. This update lets it work with both old and new kinds of addresses.
